Description: Battlereeve Tanerline awarded you these gauntlets for investigating the Sea Sload threat to Summerset.

Set: Club of the Nord Cultural Exchange
Item Name: Rigurt the Brash gave you this blunt instrument in thanks for helping him arrange an audience with the Proxy Queen.
Roguzog didn't need a blade to teach Lirendel a lesson, so he gave this dueling foil to you.
A plain silver band bestowed by Razum-dar on behalf of Queen Ayrenn, in token of your heroic actions across Summerset

Description: A mage's belt awarded by the Psijic Order for your help in solving the mystery at the Monastery of Serene Harmony.
You earned this ancient Altmer axe by exposing the alliance between the Sea Sload and the Court of Bedlam.

Item Name: You freed Ritemaster Iachesis from the control of the Sea Sload K'Tora. In thanks, he gave you this fiery Altmer staff.
The elegant cuirass of the warriors who guard the Crystal Tower, your reward for defending the Sapiarchs from a Daedric attack.
Ritemaster Iachesis awarded you these Daedric shoulder pieces for rescuing Meridia's champion.
You earned this beautiful ancient greatsword with your valor in the Daedric realm of Evergloam, but the cost was dear.
Embroidered with Psijic designs, this elegant robe is stronger than it appears.

Description: You took these Daedric greaves as a trophy of your victory over the Insatiable beneath Cey-Tarn Keep.
An ancient belt Faidur found in the half-drowned ruins of Corgrad.
Bailiff Erator gave you these enchanted breeches in thanks for dealing with the spirit of Lauriel in the Direnni Acropolis.
Andewen gave you this fine old bow for saving her from a very peculiar doom at Ebon Stadmont.
Well-made footwear, your reward for helping the Psijic Oriandra free her companions from insidious traps in Eldbur Ruins.
This box supposedly belongs to you, though your memory of it is hazy. Nonetheless, its contents will help you get back on your feet.
Some books are dangerous. You won this Daedric shield by cleansing the Illumination Academy of a very unusual spirit.
For your help at Karnwasten, Renzir gave you this mighty hammer. Hardly a smuggler's weapon, in any case.
The Sapiarchy awarded you these epaulets in gratitude for investigating the murder of one of their own.

Item Name: You earned these well-worn boots by choosing between two rival artists after the same art supplies.
The sturdy belt of a hunter accustomed to a life in the woods and hills of Summerset.

Description: A handsome pair of heavy boots, commemmorating your involvement in a tale of fake bandits and star-crossed lovers.
A flamboyant cap that conceals your features. Performers in the House of Reveries prefer anonymity.
A rather plain-looking helmet that once belonged to the killer known as the Ghost of the Green.
You defended Sea Keep from a Maormer siege. For your valor, you received this excellent Dominion armor.
The rats who live below the streets of Shimmerene have surprisingly sharp teeth.
Talomar of the Royal Menagerie gave you these fine hide gloves for putting an end to Conservator Vinelore's cruel experiments.
You earned these sturdy boots by removing the stranglers infesting Vinafwe's garden.

Item Name: The treasure chest Igeke Rat-Bite hired you to retrieve was a disappointment, but gave you this fine belt anyway.
Kinlady Ilunsare allowed you to keep her husband's magical locket after you found him dead. It meant nothing to her.

Description: A fine pair of High Elven shoulder pieces, bestowed by Kinlady Helenaere for defending Sunhold from a Maormer invasion.
This sinister Daedric staff crackles with dark enchantments. A suitable reward for exploring the Traitor's Vault.
